svg.text: Write the whole 512 bytes back to sector 3

text.font-family: Helvetica Neue, Arial, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Sector 2 and sector 4 are not touched by even 1 byte from start to finish. Only sector 3's 512 bytes move.

text.font-family: Helvetica Neue, Arial, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Even to write just 30 bytes, the round trip to the device is a 512-byte read + a 512-byte write.

text.font-family: Helvetica Neue, Arial, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans JP, sans-serif

svg.text: This round trip is called read-modify-write. A partial write in a file system always takes this shape.
